name: portfolio
title: Portfolio
description: A maker's catalogue set like a fine-press book: running heads in small capitals, numbered entries, photographs as captioned plates, a specification block on each project, a drop cap and a colophon. Bone paper, black ink, one rubric red. Neutral starter entries; the Halden Bindery example shows it finished. No plugins.

demo.tagline: Books bound by hand in a harbour town

features: Catalogue built from pages/work/*.md frontmatter, numbered newest first
Photographs as captioned plates, with srcset from files you drop in static/images
Project pages: title page, plates, a specification block with leaders, a drop cap
Running heads, a double rule and a colophon, all set in the reader's serif
System light and dark with a toggle

sampleContent.purpose: The statement and the first entries
Three starter entries that explain the frontmatter; no photographs yet
A finished catalogue with photographs, built on this template

notes: A project names its photograph with image: and imageAlt:; without one it is listed without a plate
Entries are numbered in the sort order: year, newest first, then weight
